series.name: 7 things nobody tells you before your first time
series.label: Nobody tells you this · 1 of 7

beats.vo: Your first time is not a test. Nobody's grading you.
beats.visual_intent: Empty stadium at night, floodlights on, no people.

beats.vo: She isn't there to see if you pass. She's there to be with you.
beats.visual_intent: Two bicycles parked side by side, evening light.

beats.vo: Most of the pressure you feel is pressure you're putting on yourself.
beats.visual_intent: Heavy barbell on a gym floor, dim light, no people.

beats.vo: And every other thing in this series, the nerves, the checking in, going slow, gets easier the second you stop performing and start paying attention.
You don't have to be good at this yet. You just have to be there.
beats.visual_intent: Calm ocean horizon at dawn, no people.
